title: Vampire Vape Shortz Rhubarb & Ginger
description: An exquisite fusion of two distinct flavours, this delicious e-liquid from Vampire Vape perfectly balances the sharp fruity tang of fresh rhubarb with the warm, sweet spiciness of ginger to produce and e-liquid of incredible character. These shortfill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure to shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well.
